name: Mill Hospital
worldBackground: A 1950s cottage hospital in a grimy mill town, where the clang of machinery never quite fades. The long corridor smells of antiseptic and boiled vegetables, echoing with hurried footsteps. Tension: nurses are overworked, and the town's industrial accidents are rising, straining resources.

zones.name: Hospital Grounds
zones.description: A cluster of white-painted buildings serving the town's medical needs, set amidst manicured lawns and gravel paths.

zones.name: Mill Town
zones.description: A dense cluster of terraced houses and the dominant textile mill, perpetually dirty with soot.

templates.name: Single Bed
templates.description: A narrow metal frame bed with a thin mattress, typical of hospital wards.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x2 rectangle with a slightly darker area at one end for the pillow.
templates.rule: Place in patient wards along the walls, one bed per patient space, with a small gap between beds for access.

templates.name: Double Bed
templates.description: A wooden double bed with a simple headboard, found in workers' cottages and the corner shop.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x2 square with a raised headboard on one side.
templates.rule: Place in the sleeping area of workers' cottages and the corner shop, against a wall with space for movement.

templates.name: Wooden Chair
templates.description: A simple wooden chair with a straight back, common in offices and homes.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with four small legs and a backrest indicated by a line.
templates.rule: Place around tables in wards, offices, and cottages, or against walls in waiting areas.

templates.name: Stool
templates.description: A backless wooden stool, used in operating theatre and dispensary.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square representing a simple stool with four legs.
templates.rule: Place in the operating theatre beside the surgical table, or in the dispensary by the counter.

templates.name: Table
templates.description: A rectangular wooden table for dining or work, found in wards and cottages.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x1 rectangle with four legs at the corners.
templates.rule: Place in the center of wards for nurses' stations, or in cottages for dining, with chairs around.

templates.name: Reception Desk
templates.description: A wooden desk with a drawer, serving as the admission counter in the reception lobby.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x1 rectangle with a raised counter top and a drawer indicated on one side.
templates.rule: Place against the wall in the reception lobby, facing the entrance, with chairs behind it.

templates.name: Shop Counter
templates.description: A long wooden counter for serving customers, used in the corner shop and dispensary.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x1 rectangle with a flat top and a slight overhang on one side.
templates.rule: Place against the wall in the corner shop and dispensary, with shelves behind it.

templates.name: Locker
templates.description: A metal locker with a small lock, for storing personal belongings in wards and nurses' home.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with a vertical line indicating the door and a small handle.
templates.rule: Place in patient wards beside each bed, or in rows in the nurses' dormitory.

templates.name: Shelf
templates.description: A wooden shelf unit for storing medications and supplies in the dispensary.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x1 rectangle with horizontal lines representing shelves.
templates.rule: Place against the wall in the dispensary and corner shop, with items on top.

templates.name: Cupboard
templates.description: A wooden cupboard with doors, for storing food and household items in workers' cottages.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with two doors indicated by vertical lines.
templates.rule: Place in the kitchen area of workers' cottages, against a wall near the table.

templates.name: Cabinet
templates.description: A metal medical cabinet for storing supplies in the mortuary and operating theatre.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with a glass door indicated by a cross pattern.
templates.rule: Place against the wall in the mortuary and operating theatre, near the entrance.

templates.name: Toolbox
templates.description: A metal toolbox for keeping tools in the textile mill.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with a handle on top.
templates.rule: Place on the worktable or beside machinery in the textile mill.

templates.name: Tray
templates.description: A metal tray for surgical instruments in the operating theatre.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with a raised edge.
templates.rule: Place on the surgical table or a nearby counter in the operating theatre.

templates.name: Surgical Table
templates.description: A metal table with straps for performing surgical operations.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x1 rectangle with a flat top and supports at each end.
templates.rule: Place in the center of the operating theatre, with the stool beside it.

templates.name: Mortuary Table
templates.description: A stainless steel table for storing the deceased in the mortuary.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x1 rectangle with a slightly raised edge and drainage holes indicated.
templates.rule: Place in the center of the mortuary, against a wall for access.

templates.name: Surgical Lamp
templates.description: A bright overhead lamp for illuminating the surgical area.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 circle with rays indicating light.
templates.rule: Place above the surgical table in the operating theatre.

templates.name: Lamp
templates.description: A small oil lamp or early electric lamp for general lighting.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with a small flame or bulb indicated.
templates.rule: Place on tables or bedside stands in wards, cottages, and offices.

templates.name: Industrial Lamp
templates.description: A hanging industrial lamp for lighting the mill floor.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 circle with a chain and a bright light.
templates.rule: Place hanging from the ceiling or on a post in the textile mill.

templates.name: Textile Machine
templates.description: A large loom or spinning machine for cloth production in the mill.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x2 square with complex internal lines representing machinery.
templates.rule: Place in rows along the mill floor, with space for workers to operate.

templates.name: Ambulance
templates.description: A vintage ambulance for transporting patients, parked at the hospital.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x2 rectangle with a cross symbol on the side.
templates.rule: Place in the ambulance parking area behind the hospital, facing the entrance.

templates.name: Garden Bench
templates.description: A wooden bench for sitting in the patient garden.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x2 rectangle with a backrest and armrests.
templates.rule: Place along the paths in the patient garden, facing the lawn.

templates.name: Streetlight
templates.description: A gas or electric streetlight for illuminating the cobble streets.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with a pole and a light on top.
templates.rule: Place along the cobble street and hospital walkways, at intersections and near buildings.

templates.name: Market Cross
templates.description: A stone cross marking the market area in the town center.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x2 square with a cross shape in the center.
templates.rule: Place in the center of the market area, on the cobble street.

templates.name: Mill Chimney
templates.description: A tall brick chimney for the textile mill, a dominant landmark.
templates.physicalDescription: A 3x3 square with a vertical line indicating the chimney stack.
templates.rule: Place behind the textile mill, connected to the building.

templates.name: Tree
templates.description: A deciduous tree for shading the hospital grounds and town edges.
templates.physicalDescription: A 2x2 circle with a trunk in the center.
templates.rule: Scatter in the patient garden and along the edges of the hospital grounds.

templates.name: Bush
templates.description: A small bush for decoration in gardens and along paths.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 irregular shape representing foliage.
templates.rule: Cluster in the patient garden or scatter along the hospital walkways.

templates.name: Rubble
templates.description: A pile of rubble or debris from industrial activity.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 irregular shape with jagged edges.
templates.rule: Place in alleys and abandoned areas of the mill town, near the mill.

templates.name: Trash Can
templates.description: A metal trash can for waste on the streets.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 cylinder with a lid.
templates.rule: Place along the cobble street, near the corner shop and market cross.

templates.name: Staircase
templates.description: A wooden staircase for moving between storeys in the nurses' home.
templates.physicalDescription: A 1x1 square with steps indicated by parallel lines.
templates.rule: Place in the center of the nurses' home, connecting the two storeys.

templates.name: Enamelled iron school desk
templates.description: A varnished pine school desk for a single pupil, with a lift-up lid and a groove for pencils.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small school desk: a honey varnished pine top sloping toward the bottom edge, a pencil groove along the top, dark green enamelled iron legs.

templates.name: Flannel wingback armchair
templates.description: A deep wingback armchair with broad arms and a plump red flannel cushion.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a roomy wingback armchair: wide chestnut stained beech arms either side, a red flannel seat cushion, a padded back along the top edge.

templates.name: Stained beech wooden bench
templates.description: A stained beech wooden bench on splayed legs, long enough for two to sit shoulder to shoulder.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a backless wooden bench: one long mid-brown stained beech board, the leg ends showing at each short edge.

templates.name: Stained beech narrow wardrobe
templates.description: A stained beech narrow wardrobe barely wider than its door, a single change of clothes hanging inside.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a slim narrow wardrobe: square mid-brown stained beech top, a single door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

templates.name: Enamelled iron storm lantern
templates.description: An enamelled iron storm lantern set down on the floor, throwing a ring of light big enough to work by.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a storm lantern: a round dark green enamelled iron cap with a carrying handle, glowing warm amber glass showing all round its rim, set in a dark iron frame.

templates.name: Varnished pine shop counter
templates.description: A bentwood shop counter, its edge rubbed smooth where coins and goods change hands.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a shop counter two cells wide: honey bentwood top, a small till box at one end, the keeper's side along the top edge with a few wrapped parcels waiting there.

templates.name: Stained beech hatstand
templates.description: A stained beech hatstand with a coat or two hanging from its hooks and a hat on top.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a hatstand: small round chestnut stained beech base, a central post with four hooks pointing outward, a coat draped over one side.

templates.name: Stained beech clerk's desk
templates.description: A stained beech clerk's desk with one shallow drawer and just enough room for papers and a light.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a plain clerk's desk: a chestnut stained beech top with a few papers and a pen, the back edge at the top.

templates.name: Bentwood filing cabinet
templates.description: A bentwood filing cabinet with four labelled drawers, the bottom one jammed shut.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a filing cabinet: plain brown bentwood top with a wire tray of papers, drawer handles along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

templates.name: Sheet steel iron shelf
templates.description: A sheet steel iron shelf holding tins, coils of cable, spare parts and odds and ends that needed somewhere to go.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small iron shelf: grey sheet steel uprights at the four corners, a slatted top shelf with boxes and coiled cable, back against the top edge.

templates.name: Bentwood tavern booth
templates.description: A tavern booth with a padded brown cowhide seat and a high back that hides its sitters from the room.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a fixed tavern booth: a long brown cowhide bench seat with a tall padded back along the top edge, honey bentwood end panels at left and right.

templates.name: Varnished pine small round table
templates.description: A varnished pine small round table just big enough for two cups and a game of cards.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small round table: a round amber varnished pine top on a single central post.

templates.name: Sheet steel fireplace
templates.description: A slate fireplace set into the wall, its sheet steel firedogs holding a fire that warms the whole room.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a wall fireplace: a blue-grey slate hearth slab jutting from the top edge, a dark firebox against the back wall with a grey sheet steel grate of burning logs, a raised hearthstone along the bottom.

templates.name: Bentwood wardrobe
templates.description: A bentwood wardrobe with two tall doors that never quite meet, coats and shirts crowded inside.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a wardrobe two cells wide: flat honey bentwood top with a hatbox at one end, double doors with enamelled iron handles along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

templates.name: Stained beech commode
templates.description: A stained beech commode with a padded flannel lid, a respectable box with a pot hidden inside.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a boxy commode: a square mid-brown stained beech chest with a hinged lid along the back edge, a grey flannel cushion on top, a carrying handle on each side.

templates.name: Sheet steel wash basin
templates.description: A sheet steel bowl of cold water set on a stool, with a scrap of cloth and a sliver of soap beside it.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a wash basin: a round grey sheet steel bowl of water on a square chestnut stained beech stool, a folded rag and a jug beside it.

templates.name: Sheet steel tin bath
templates.description: A sheet steel tin bath dragged out on bath night, for laundry the rest of the week.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a round tin bath: a grey sheet steel tub with grey soapy water, a scrubbing board leaning in it, wet splashes on the floor around.

templates.name: Flannel iron ward bed
templates.description: A cast iron ward bed on castors, its side rails raised and the patient's record hung at the foot.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a wheeled iron ward bed: black cast iron side rails, a red flannel sheet, the head section raised at the top, castors at the corners.

templates.name: Pressed glass drip stand
templates.description: An enamelled iron drip stand on wheels, a pressed glass bag dripping slowly into a tube.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a drip stand: a small five-spoked wheeled base with a thin enamelled iron pole, a clear pressed glass bag hanging from a hook at the top.

templates.name: Sheet steel medicine cabinet
templates.description: A medicine cabinet with a pressed glass-fronted door, its shelves crowded with bottles, salves and rolled bandages.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a narrow medicine cabinet: grey sheet steel top, a pressed glass door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

templates.name: Wool serge hammock
templates.description: A navy wool serge hammock slung between two hooks, swaying at a touch.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a slung hammock: a long navy wool serge sling pinched at both ends, ropes running to hooks at the top and bottom.

templates.name: Enamelled iron chest
templates.description: A bentwood chest with a flat lid and a hasp but no lock, the kind every household keeps.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a chest: plank honey bentwood lid with two enamelled iron straps across it, a simple hasp on one long edge.

templates.name: Enamelled iron candlestick stand
templates.description: An enamelled iron candlestick stand holding one fat candle, its wax run down in long tears.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a candlestick stand: a small round cream enamelled iron drip pan with a single lit candle in the middle, a soft yellow halo around it.

templates.name: Sheet steel turnstile
templates.description: A sheet steel turnstile that lets one person through at a time and clanks about it.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a turnstile: a round grey sheet steel post at one side with three sheet steel arms fanning out across a narrow lane, a card reader on top.

templates.name: Sheet steel coal boiler
templates.description: A sheet steel coal boiler in the back room, its little window glowing as it heats water for the whole house.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a coal boiler against the top wall: a round grey sheet steel drum with pipes and valves rising at the back, a small glowing fire door or pilot window at the bottom edge.

templates.name: Bentwood kitchen chair
templates.description: A bentwood kitchen chair, plain and straight-backed, with one leg a touch shorter than the rest.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a simple kitchen chair: a square brown bentwood seat with the backrest along the top edge.

templates.name: Plate glass gas lamp
templates.description: A cast iron gas lamp with a plate glass globe, hissing faintly as it burns.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a standing gas lamp: a round clear plate glass globe glowing white-gold, a black cast iron post and base beneath, a thin gas pipe running to the wall.

templates.name: Bentwood night table
templates.description: A bentwood night table with one drawer for keepsakes and a top for a light.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small night table: a square brown bentwood top, a drawer pull showing on the bottom edge.

templates.name: Wicker potted palm
templates.description: A potted palm in a bentwood planter, tall enough to brush the ceiling beams.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of the potted palm: a square honey bentwood planter under a wide round crown of honey leaves that spills past its edges.

templates.name: Sheet steel keg
templates.description: A sheet steel keg, cold to the touch, with a coupler and hose still clamped to its neck.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a round keg: domed grey sheet steel top inside a ring of hand-holes, a coupler at the centre trailing a short hose.

templates.name: Striped ticking settee
templates.description: A blue-striped settee with two deep cushions and a scatter of pillows.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a two-seat settee: blue-striped ticking cushions, a padded back along the top edge, rolled honey bentwood arms at left and right.

templates.name: Wool serge tailor's bench
templates.description: A tailor's bench where a bolt of navy wool serge waits half-chalked for the shears.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a tailor's bench: a smooth honey varnished pine top with a length of navy wool serge spread across it, shears, chalk and pins, a rack of bolts along the top edge.

templates.name: Bentwood tool rack
templates.description: A tool rack with an outline painted round each hanging tool, so a missing one shows at once.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a tool rack: brown bentwood board against the top edge with sheet steel hand tools hung on a row of pegs, a narrow tray of fixings along the bottom.

templates.name: Stained beech crate
templates.description: A stained beech crate sealed tight, a shipper's mark stamped on its side.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a square crate: mid-brown stained beech lid with reinforced edges and a stencilled mark in one corner.

templates.name: Bentwood deal table
templates.description: A bentwood deal table, big enough for a meal for two or a pile of chores.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a plain deal table: a rectangular brown bentwood top, twice as wide as it is deep, legs at the corners.

templates.name: Striped ticking welding bench
templates.description: A welding bench with a slag-spattered cast iron top and a striped ticking spark curtain hung behind it.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a welding bench: a thick dark grey cast iron slab top with clamps and scorch marks, a gas bottle and coiled hose at the top-right corner, a grey-striped ticking spark curtain along the top edge.

templates.name: Stained beech icebox
templates.description: A stained beech icebox lined with sheet steel, a block of ice sweating in the top and a drip pan that someone forgot to empty.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a square icebox: a chestnut stained beech top with brass hinges along the back edge, a hinged lid showing a grey sheet steel-lined ice compartment, a drip tray peeking out at the bottom.

templates.name: Stained beech loaded pallet
templates.description: A loaded pallet stacked chest-high with sacks and cartons and bound in wool serge.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a square loaded pallet: boxes stacked in a tight block under black wool serge wrapping, the stained beech slats showing at the edges.

templates.name: York stone bust on a pedestal
templates.description: A york stone bust on a pedestal, some stern ancestor or patron gazing over the room.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of the bust on a pedestal: a square brown bentwood pedestal topped by a buff york stone head and shoulders, face toward the bottom.

templates.name: Pressed glass paraffin lamp
templates.description: A pressed glass paraffin lamp on a bentwood stand, its little flame steady as long as no one opens the door.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small honey bentwood stand with a paraffin lamp: an amber pressed glass lamp seen from above, a single flame at its spout and a ring of warm light.

templates.name: Stained beech low tea table
templates.description: A low stained beech low tea table at knee height, set out in front of the seats.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a low tea table: a long chestnut stained beech top with a lower shelf showing beneath.

templates.name: Sheet steel pot-belly stove
templates.description: A sheet steel pot-belly stove that ticks as it heats, a kettle never far from its top.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a squat pot-belly stove: a round grey sheet steel top with a kettle ring, a flue pipe rising from the back near the top edge, a small glowing door on the bottom side.

templates.name: Cast iron cookstove
templates.description: A little cast iron cookstove with two plates on top and an oven no bigger than a loaf.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small cookstove: a square dark grey cast iron top with two round hot plates, a stovepipe at the top edge, a firebox door glowing at the bottom.

templates.name: Cast iron footlocker
templates.description: A cast iron footlocker meant for the foot of a bunk, stencilled with a number and held shut by cowhide straps.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a low footlocker: rectangular black cast iron lid with a stencilled number, two brown straps across it, a handle at either end.

templates.name: Enamelled iron steel drum
templates.description: An enamelled iron steel drum with ribbed sides and a hazard mark half scraped away.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a round steel drum: flat cream enamelled iron lid with a rolled rim and two small screw caps, one near the edge.

templates.name: Varnished pine goods shelf
templates.description: A varnished pine goods shelf crowded with wares, the cheap goods low down and the dear ones within the keeper's reach.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a shallow goods shelf two cells wide: amber varnished pine shelf edge along the bottom, back panel against the top edge, rows of jars, boxes and bundles packed tight.

templates.name: Calico double bedstead
templates.description: A sheet steel double bedstead wide enough for two, under a cream calico quilt.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a double bedstead: grey sheet steel frame, a cream calico quilt, two pillows side by side against the headboard at the top.

npcs.name: Evelyn Hart

npcs.name: Margaret O'Connell
npcs.description: Margaret aims to save enough for a down payment on a house, yet she fears the rising rent will swallow her savings.

npcs.name: Alice Penrose

npcs.name: Dorothy Whitaker

npcs.name: Ethel Brown
npcs.description: Ethel wants to be home to care for her sick child, but she worries that the hospital will not grant her leave.
npcs.physicalDescription: Plump and warm, she wears a wool coat over her uniform; a simple wedding ring glints on her finger.

npcs.name: Mabel Carter
npcs.description: Mabel dreams of opening a private clinic, though she fears the debt that would follow.
npcs.physicalDescription: Average in height, she wears a floral apron over her dress; a small mole sits on her chin.

npcs.name: Thomas Reed
npcs.description: Thomas seeks acceptance among the nursing staff, but he worries that prejudice will keep him from being treated as an equal.

npcs.name: Ruth Lang

npcs.name: Harold Finch

npcs.name: Agnes Finch
npcs.description: Agnes keeps the shop's ledger with her husband Harold, dreaming of a holiday by the sea.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tall and wiry, with a floral apron and a silver locket.

npcs.name: Frank Evans
npcs.description: Frank works as a clerk at the hospital with his wife Lily, hoping to save enough for a better home.
npcs.physicalDescription: Medium build, with a neat shirt and a pocket watch.

npcs.name: Lily Evans
npcs.description: Lily weaves cotton at the mill alongside her husband Frank's hospital job, fearing the mill's closures.

npcs.name: Tommy Evans
npcs.description: Tommy spends his days playing in the alley, dreaming of becoming a doctor like his father.

npcs.name: Nell Evans
npcs.description: Nell helps her mother Lily with chores, wishing she could go to school instead.
npcs.physicalDescription: Frail, with a shawl and a quiet demeanor.

npcs.name: George Harris
npcs.description: George manages the hospital's reception with his wife Martha, frustrated by the limited resources.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tall and thin, with a stern expression and a clipboard.

npcs.name: Martha Harris
npcs.description: Martha works the loom at the mill while her husband George administers the hospital, resenting the long hours.
npcs.physicalDescription: Broad-shouldered, with a kerchief on her head.

npcs.name: Peter Harris
npcs.description: Peter skips school to read books, aspiring to be a writer like his hero Dickens.
npcs.physicalDescription: Thin, with ink-stained fingers and a notebook in his pocket.

npcs.name: Susan Harris
npcs.description: Susan helps her mother Martha with the household, dreaming of escaping the mill town.
npcs.physicalDescription: Bright-eyed, with a ribbon in her hair.

npcs.name: Hilda Grant
npcs.description: Hilda Grant, the pharmacist and wife of Ernest, works diligently to manage the dispensary amidst the town's industrial chaos, wanting to improve public health, but she worries about the shortage of essential medicines.
npcs.physicalDescription: medium build, wears a practical wool dress with a white pharmacist's coat, and her silver-rimmed glasses reflect her attentive nature.

npcs.name: Ernest Grant
npcs.description: Ernest Grant, a mill worker and husband to Hilda, toils endlessly at the textile mill, seeking better wages for his family, but he fears the constant threat of accidents on the noisy floor.
npcs.physicalDescription: sturdy build, dressed in worn overalls with a lunch pail, and his hands are calloused from years of handling machinery.

npcs.name: Linda Grant
npcs.description: Linda Grant, the pharmacist's daughter, assists with household chores while dreaming of becoming a nurse, wanting to help others like her mother, but she worries about her mother's exhausting work hours.

npcs.name: David Grant
npcs.description: David Grant, the mill worker's son, plays energetically near the mill races, aspiring to work in the mill like his father, but he fears the dangerous machinery that dominates his world.
npcs.physicalDescription: wiry build, dressed in short trousers with a cap, and he has a toy mill crafted from scrap metal.

npcs.name: Anne Grant
npcs.description: Anne Grant, the mill worker's mother, spends her days mending clothes and tending the garden, hoping for her family's safety, but she worries about the long-term health effects of mill dust on her son.

npcs.name: Walter Parker

npcs.name: Clara Parker

npcs.name: Jane Parker
npcs.description: Jane Parker, the mortician's daughter, withdraws into books and the cemetery, wanting to understand the cycle of life and death, but she worries about her father's emotional distance and her own sense of belonging.

npcs.name: Robert Parker

npcs.name: Arthur Jones

npcs.name: Susan Jones

npcs.name: Colin Anderson

player.name: Eleanor Vance
player.description: A dedicated public health inspector from the city, here to assess and improve the hospital's response to the rising tide of industrial accidents.
player.physicalDescription: Of medium build with keen, observant eyes, dressed in a practical wool skirt and blouse, with a formal hat perched on her head and a leather satchel always at her side.

narrativeRules: Emphasize the relentless industrial noise and soot to underscore the town's grimy atmosphere.
Highlight the strain on nurses and doctors due to rising industrial accidents.
Introduce unexpected events like equipment failures or sudden patient influxes.
Use hourly updates to track changing conditions in the hospital and town.
Incorporate rumours and gossip to add depth to interactions and plot twists.
Maintain a tense tone, reflecting the high stakes of medical care in a resource-strapped setting.
